title: Public site: a Pause motion control and a forced-colors focus ring (WCAG 2.2.2, 2.4.7)
detail:
Follow-up the meta scan listed under SCAN-1114. Re-tested first: scroll-padding under the fixed header already exists (kit-site.css, 84px + 16px) and prefers-reduced-motion already quiets the site, so those two are not gaps. Two real gaps remained. (1) Auto-playing sweeps and signal lines had no user pause for visitors who have not set the OS option: the footer now has a Pause motion button (aria-pressed, remembered on the device) that sets data-motion on the kit root, stops every keyframe in CSS and stands SiteFx down. (2) The Frequency form fields set outline:0 and draw focus as a box-shadow, which forced-colors mode discards: a forced-colors outline now restores the ring.

Footer Pause motion button and forced-colors focus outline landed; scroll-padding and reduced-motion already existed.

verify.note: Pause control in the footer, honoured in CSS, plus a forced-colors focus outline.
